critical_code_review_comments: scheduling_routes.py list_appointments non-admin filter relies on matching user.email to professionals.email. If a professional user doesn't have a matching professional record, query['professional_id'] is not set and they would see ALL company appointments - consider returning empty list when no professional match and role is professional to avoid data leakage
Dashboard.js is very large (~2000+ lines). Recommend splitting ConfigPage / ClientsPage / MySitePage into separate files for maintainability
